nora: quick triage — new community ckpt 'zenith7b-lite' int4 onboard shows embedding drop on long summaries. float avg cos ~0.91, int4 ~0.70.

eval-bot: eval/4999990000 finished: task=summarize-embed, baseline=0.912, zenith7b-int4=0.702, delta=-0.210 :warning:

ash: did converter preserve rotary metadata? some community ckpts include per-head scaling arrays.

nora: converter log shows rotary_meta present but we only surface a single float in runtime manifest. converter used: `tools/convert_model.py --src zenith/ckpt --dst redwood/zenith7b-lite --quant int4 --manifest`

sasha: can you paste excerpt from ckpt meta and a tokenization diff for failing examples? sometimes AD (soft-hyphen) normalization differs.

nora: ckpt meta snippet included: "rotary": {"mode": "per_head", "scales": [1.02,0.98,1.02,0.98,1.02,0.98,1.02,0.98]}. token diff small (~0.9%) but embedding drop larger.

ash: sounds like per-head rotary mismatch + quant rounding piling into kv-cache. propose quick bisect: 1) float + our tokenizer, 2) float + ckpt tokenizer, 3) int4 + manual per-head shim (apply scale at kv write), 4) int4 + alternate kernel (stable).

eval-bot: jobs kicked: 4999990000-1..4 (subset=300)

eval-bot: 4999990000-1 done: float+our-tokenizer=0.905
eval-bot: 4999990000-2 done: float+ckpt-tokenizer=0.912
eval-bot: 4999990000-3 done: int4+shim(write)=0.781
eval-bot: 4999990000-4 done: int4+stable-kernel+shim(write)=0.795

sasha: nice — rescaling on write recovers ~0.08, kernel tuning another ~0.01-0.02. tokenizer only explains ~0.007 diff.

nora: i'll prototype a small runtime toggle: `manifest.rotary.mode == \"per_head\" -> enable kv_rescale_on_write = true`. will run full eval overnight.

ash: add onboarding lint: emit WARN if ckpt.rotary.mode == per_head and runtime default is uniform. also record per-head scales in model manifest so runtime can auto-enable.

sasha: agree. if full eval recovers >0.85 we can land shim+manifest work. otherwise consider keeping stable kernel fallback for longctx int4.

nora: filing ticket RI-55667 with smoke logs, token diffs, and failing pairs. will post full results here.
